output.content: I was tracing the batch ingestion logs for the last three weeks and noticed the pipeline jumps straight from the raw feature extraction step to the model training queue. There is no intermediate validation stage where the system compares the incoming batch statistics against the historical baseline. I checked the scheduler configuration and the code repository, and the drift detection module is not present in the deployment manifest. Consequently, every nightly run proceeds without any automated comparison of distribution shifts. The data flows directly into the training environment as soon as the extraction job completes successfully, with no intermediate gate to flag anomalies in the feature ranges.
